entries.zh: 藏匿、挟藏（把东西藏起来，或藏在身上带走）
entries.en: to hide, to conceal something; to carry something away concealed
entries.notes: H「兜带」与 R「rěn tay」对音不合，义依 L「esconder ocultar algo」与 M tau hià 定。

entries.zh: 容隐、包庇（隐瞒他人的恶行而不加纠正）
entries.en: to conceal and shelter (another's wrongdoing); to connive at evil without correcting it

entries.zh: 窝藏、收留（把人或物收起来藏匿）
entries.en: to harbor, to take in and conceal (persons or goods)
entries.notes: L「los ledi eroi」拼写残乱，推为 los ladrones（盗贼）；义依 H「兜收」与 L 定。

entries.en: to gather up and conceal; to pick up and hide away
entries.notes: L 承上条残乱作「los ledieron」，义依 H「兜執」与 M tau chîp 定。

entries.zh: 堵塞、封闭（遮塞使不外露）
entries.en: to block up, to shut off; to conceal by stopping up
entries.notes: L「los ama」残乱不可解，义依 H「閉塞」与 R「pī fě」定。

entries.en: to dodge, to slip aside out of sight
entries.notes: H 原字标疑（閃/閔），依 M fiām 取「閃」。

entries.zh: 躲闪、藏身（字形疑为「閃」之讹）
entries.en: to dodge and hide oneself; to slip out of view
entries.notes: H「玷」标疑，M 作 fiām、pia 两读，与 R tiēn 不合，义从「閃避」。

entries.en: to avoid, to evade, to keep out of the way
entries.notes: M 栏原件残损（T99），义依 H「避」、R pȳ 与 L「esconderse」定。

entries.en: to walk away and hide in a retired place; to keep out of sight
entries.notes: H「行僻」与 R「kiěng pȳ」对音不全，僻取「避」义。

entries.en: to flee and hide; to run off and evade
entries.notes: H 末字标疑（僻/避），M 作 to to pia，取「逃僻（避）」义。

entries.en: to flee and dodge; to slip away from
to evade, to escape, to get away from
to run off and hide; to flee out of sight
entries.notes: L 末「huirse」明指逃；H 末字标疑、M 末二音（fiam huiu）残缺，义只取「走去…躲」。

entries.zh: 藏、收藏（把自身或物藏起来）
entries.en: to hide, to store away; to conceal oneself
to flee; to dodge a blow
to hide behind (someone's) back; to screen oneself
entries.notes: H「暲」标疑（暲/障），M iap 与 R hiâ 不合，义依 L「de tras las espaldas」定。

entries.zh: 躲在后头藏身（形迹隐蔽于后）
entries.en: to hide behind; to keep oneself concealed at the rear
entries.notes: L 严重残乱（「esconder el dtdor v no」不可复原），H 标疑、M 末音不明，语义难定。

entries.zh: 以下避上、下属躲避上司
entries.en: for a subordinate to hide from his superior; to avoid one's better
entries.notes: H「愷上」标疑且 M「cay cay cu」不可解，仅 L「el inferior del su perior」可据，语义存疑。

entries.en: to lie low, to crouch and hide behind

entries.zh: 与盗贼一同仓皇躲藏、慌乱藏身
entries.en: to hide along with thieves in a headlong rush; to bolt into hiding
entries.notes: H「亂暲」标疑，M 次音污损（T99），义依 L「a tropellada mente」定。

entries.en: to put one's head out (in fear); to peek out from hiding
entries.notes: L「detemor sacandola cabeza」拼写残乱，义依 H「吐頭」与 M thū thau 定。

entries.en: to dive; to hide under the water like a fish
to dodge and avoid; to hide oneself from notice
entries.notes: L「por nolexpar」残乱，三栏仅存「僻、閃、避」可读，义据残存音字定。

entries.zh: 蹲伏躲藏、屈身藏于其后
entries.en: to crouch down and hide; to stoop out of sight behind
entries.notes: H「屈落下」与 M「cun to que」对音不全，义依 L 与 H 定。
